items.headline: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds (chest) out for year, source says
items.description: Giants linebacker Tremaine Edmunds will miss the rest of the season with a torn chest muscle, a source told ESPN's Jordan Raanan. Edmunds leads the team with 50 tackles and wears the green dot to make the calls on defense.
